```lean
intro a b ha hb
have h1 : 0 < a + b := add_pos ha hb
have h2 : 0 < 1 / a := inv_pos ha
have h3 : 0 < 1 / b := inv_pos hb
have h4 : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = (a + b) * (1 / a) + (a + b) * (1 / b) := by rfl
simp only [h4, mul_add] at h4
have h5 : (a + b) * (1 / a) = 1 + b / a := by simp [mul_div_left]
have h6 : (a + b) * (1 / b) = 1 + a / b := by simp [mul_div_right]
simp only [h5, h6] at h4
have h7 : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = 2 + b / a + a / b := by simp [h4, h5, h6]
simp only [h7] at h4
have h8 : b / a + a / b ≥ 2 := by apply Real.add_inv_self_ge_two; exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
have h9 : 2 + (b / a + a / b) ≥ 2 + 2 := add_right_mono h8
simp only [h9] at h4
exact le_refl 4
```
